asks: When did you last lie on anything soft?
Do you want to know what is under it?
Are you going to sleep or not?
description: A long low bank of moss, deep green and springy and a good foot thick, grown into exactly the shape and place of the cot. It is warm from underneath and it smells like the ground after rain.
emotes: {it} springs slowly back where something pressed it.
{it} releases a faint green smell into the room.
{it} puts out one more small white flower.
looks: Pressing a hand into it, the moss comes back up slowly and completely.
There are small white flowers through it in the places nobody has lain.
It is warm from below, steadily, as though there is something under it.
name: a bank of deep moss
says: You would sleep. That is the risk.
The warm comes up from underneath. Do not ask.
